scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8876 --reload
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @dbzs/shared test && pnpm --filter @dbzs/desktop test && cd backend && uv run pytest
scripts.test:capabilities: pnpm --filter @dbzs/desktop test:capabilities && cd backend && uv run pytest tests/test_coding_assistant_capabilities.py tests/test_coding_assistant_scenarios.py -q
scripts.test:coding-loop: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/test_coding_loop_acceptance.py -q
scripts.test:rag-index: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/test_workspace_index.py -q
scripts.test:rag-retrieval: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/test_hybrid_retrieval.py -q
scripts.test:reasoning-trace: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/test_reasoning_trace.py -q && cd .. && pnpm --filter @dbzs/desktop exec vitest run src/components/RuntimeChatTab.test.tsx src/testing/chatActions.test.ts
scripts.smoke:backend: cd backend && uv run python scripts/smoke_backend.py
scripts.smoke:packaging: cd backend && uv run python build.py
scripts.doctor:backend: cd backend && uv run python scripts/doctor_backend.py
